Container.Name: goodreads-mcp
Container.Overview:
Read-only MCP server for Goodreads (fork of shreeyachand/goodreads-mcp with a Streamable HTTP entry point). Search books, details, reviews, similar books, series, editions, public shelves. No login, no cookies: it reads public Goodreads pages, RSS and the site's own GraphQL backend.
MCP endpoint: http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/mcp Health: http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/health
The server has no auth of its own. It is published only through the Cloudflare Tunnel behind an Access service token and the mcp.batubozkan.com portal. Do not port forward it.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Host port of the MCP endpoint (/mcp) and /health.

Config.Name: GOODREADS_USER_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Numeric Goodreads profile id (goodreads.com/user/show/ID-name), the default for get_shelf and list_shelves. The profile must be public.

Config.Name: GOODREADS_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Optional Host header allowlist (comma separated, host:* allowed). Empty turns the DNS rebinding check off.
